status: Public source patch prerelease and website live; v0.1.9-alpha.2 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source patch prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: The v0.1.9-alpha.2 hub release candidate pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.9, whose --simulator mode never reads device credentials, with ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.11 and Linux SDK and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. On 12 October 2026 the public guide's commands ran from fresh clones, and the gateway first-success path ran beside a running gateway. The owner's OLED kit passed USB and Wi-Fi acceptance and now runs released alpha.11 firmware; native Grok Bot MCP calls and independent reproduction are not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; Wi-Fi device listener used by one physical kit; Grok Bot local-command route observed
components.checks: 201 tests, Ruff, plain-language checks, the first-success check, package builds and twine check passed; the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed. --simulator without --credentials reads no device registry and opens no device port; alpha.8's port-in-use message and wifi-provision board check stand. The LAN listener is unchanged from alpha.6. Native Grok Bot MCP calls and the tunnel route are not verified.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.7; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. Adds --version and the release workflow; the gateway extra pins v0.1.0-alpha.7. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (8/8), the contract check, the gateway PTY integration and three firmware builds passed. Alpha.11 adds a 48x48 Grok Bot face and label while Online; the owner checked it on the kit on 12 October 2026, and text beside it is host-tested only. Alpha.10's wrong-password check and provisioning fix and alpha.8's USB and Wi-Fi acceptance stand. One kit; not independently reproduced.

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
